Definitions . Capitalized terms used and not defined in this Amendment shall have the respective meanings given them in the Credit Agreement. 2. Amendment to Credit Agreement . Clause (j) of the definition of “Eligible Accounts” set forth on Schedule 1.1(a) to the Credit Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety as set forth in Exhibit A to this Amendment. 3. Amendment Fee . In addition to all other fees, costs and expenses payable by Borrowers to Lender pursuant to the Credit Agreement, Borrowers shall pay to Lender an amendment fee equal to $1,000 (such fee, the “ Amendment Fee ”), which Amendment Fee shall be fully earned, due and payable as of the date hereof and may be charged by Lender to the Loan Account. 4. Conditions to Effectiveness . The effectiveness of this Amendment shall be subject to the receipt by Lender of: (i) an original (or electronic copy) of this Amendment duly authorized, executed and delivered by Borrowers and (ii) the Amendment Fee. 5. Effect of this Amendment . Except as amended pursuant hereto, no other amendments or modifications to the Credit Agreement are intended or implied and in all other respects the Credit Agreement is hereby specifically ratified, restated and confirmed by all parties hereto as of the effective date hereof. To the extent of conflict between the terms of this Amendment and the Credit Agreement, the terms of this Amendment shall control. 6. Further Assurances . Borrowers shall execute and deliver such additional documents and take such additional action as may be reasonably requested by Lender to effectuate the provisions and purposes of this Amendment. ​

# Investment Memorandum

## 1. Executive Summary

- On May 22, 2024, Innodata Inc. and its subsidiaries entered into a first amendment to their credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association.
- Innodata Inc. is a Delaware corporation with multiple subsidiaries including Innodata Synodex LLC, Innodata Docgenix LLC, Agility PR Solutions LLC, and Innodata Services LLC, all serving as borrowers under the facility.
- The original credit agreement was established on April 4, 2023, between the borrower group and Wells Fargo Bank as the sole lender.
- The purpose of this amendment is to modify clause (j) of the definition of "Eligible Accounts" as set forth in the original credit agreement, though the specific changes are referenced in Exhibit A which is not included in the document.
- Innodata appears to be a data services and technology company based on its subsidiary names, operating through multiple Delaware entities with varying ownership structures.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
- Established banking relationship with Wells Fargo, a major U.S. financial institution, indicating lender confidence in the credit profile
- Relatively recent credit facility (originated April 2023) suggests updated due diligence and current market terms
- Multiple subsidiary guarantors provide additional credit support through cross-default provisions
- Low amendment fee of only $1,000 suggests minor modifications rather than significant covenant relief

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
- Limited information available on the specific nature of the "Eligible Accounts" modification, restricting ability to assess impact on borrowing capacity
- Single lender structure may limit refinancing flexibility compared to syndicated facilities
- Company appears to have interim CFO (Marissa Espineli), which could indicate recent management changes or transition period
